Simple & Transparent

How Petify works

No warehouses full of dusty stock, no inflated prices. Here's exactly what happens when you order.

1

You place your order

You check out through PayPal — your card details never touch our site, and you get an order confirmation by email right away.

2

We prepare it with our supplier

We personally pass your order to our fulfillment partner, who picks, quality-checks, and packs your item — usually within 1–2 business days.

3

It arrives at your door

Tracked delivery in 5–10 business days across the USA. If your pet doesn't love it, our 30-day happiness guarantee has you covered.

Fulfilled by CJ Dropshipping — our supplier partner

We source through CJ Dropshipping, one of the world's largest pet-product fulfillment networks, with US warehouses for faster delivery. Every order is confirmed and quality-checked by a real person on our team before it ships — that's our semi-automatic promise: technology for speed, humans for care.

US warehouse shipping available
Why Petify

Shopping that wags its tail

Free & fast US shipping

Free on orders over $40, flat $4.95 under that. Tracked from our door to yours in 5–10 business days.

30-day happiness guarantee

If your pet isn't thrilled, return it within 30 days for a full refund. No forms, no fuss, no sad puppies.

Checkout by PayPal

Pay with your PayPal balance or any card through PayPal. Your payment details stay with PayPal — always. (Live the moment the store’s PayPal account is connected at launch.)

Real humans, real help

Questions about sizing, shipping, or a picky cat? Our pet-obsessed support team replies within one business day.

Our Promise

A brand-new store with old-fashioned service

Petify just opened its doors, and we'd rather earn your trust than borrow it. So here's what we commit to — in writing — from our very first order:

✓ Our commitment

Checked by hand, every time. A real person on our team confirms and quality-checks your order with our supplier before it ships — no blind drop-shipping, ever.

✓ Our commitment

Honest timelines. We tell you 5–10 business days because that's the truth, and we email your tracking number the moment your package is moving.

✓ Our commitment

Zero-risk first order. Covered by our own 30-day happiness guarantee — and, once PayPal checkout goes live at launch, PayPal Buyer Protection too. If your pet isn't thrilled, you don't pay for it. Simple.

Most US orders arrive in 5–10 business days. Items stocked in our supplier's US warehouses ship fastest (often 3–5 days). Every order includes tracking, emailed to you as soon as your package is on its way.

We accept PayPal — pay with your PayPal balance, bank, or any major card through PayPal's secure checkout. You'll never enter card details on our website, and every payment is covered by PayPal Buyer Protection once checkout is live at launch.

Then we don't want your money. Every order is covered by our 30-day happiness guarantee: contact us within 30 days of delivery and we'll arrange a return and a full refund.
